variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
